senses.gloss: m. Ar.) (חָמַר I; v. P. Sm. 1310 s. v. חומרא) [whatever joins or is joined,] bead, little ball (bulla) hung around the neck; jewel, clasp, seal; trnsf. כמין ח׳ like a jewel, i.e. a precious ethical principle (cmp.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 22b:5">Kidd. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>היה דורש כמין ח׳ …</he> interpreted this in a symbolical way (giving the practical Biblical law about perforating the slave’s ear an ethical signification); Mekh. Mishp, N’zik., s. 2 <he>כמו חומר</he> (Var. <he>אומר</he>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Sotah 15a:13">Sot. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>אדרשנה כמין ח׳</he> I shall interpret it symbolically.—Pl. <he>חֲמוּרוֹת</he> (fr. <he>חמור</he>, cmp. <cite ref="H01166"><he>חֲמוּרְתָּא</he></cite>).
